```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(stringr)
library(scales)

# 1. Chemin du fichier
file_path <- "resultats_hebdo.xlsx"

# Séquence des dates hebdomadaires
dates_semaines <- seq(from = as.Date("2025-06-16"), to = as.Date("2025-08-11"), by = "1 week")

# Noms de toutes les colonnes du tableau
cols_all <- c("date_deb_xl", "date_fin_xl", "nb_obs", "nb_cell",
              "auc_top1", "auc_top2", "auc_top3", "auc_moy", "auc_std",
              "kt_top1", "kt_top2", "kt_top3", "kt_moy", "kt_std",
              "ic_apex_moy", "std_ic_apex")

load_sheet <- function(sheet, mode_label) {
  df <- read_excel(file_path, sheet = sheet, skip = 1, col_names = cols_all, col_types = "text")
  
  df <- df %>% 
    select(-date_deb_xl, -date_fin_xl) %>% 
    mutate(across(everything(), ~ str_replace_all(., ",", "."))) %>% 
    mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric)) %>% 
    mutate(
      date_deb = dates_semaines[1:n()],
      modele = mode_label,
      label_annot = paste0("n=", nb_obs, "\ncell=", nb_cell)
    )
  return(df)
}

# Chargement des deux onglets
m  <- load_sheet("modele", "Modèle classique (18 covariables)")
md <- load_sheet("modele_degrade", "Modèle dégradé (8 covariables)")

df_combined <- bind_rows(m, md)

# --- Configuration graphique ---
palette_couleurs <- c(
  "Modèle classique (18 covariables)" = "#1f77b4",
  "Modèle dégradé (8 covariables)"  = "#d62728"
)

styles_lignes <- c(
  "Modèle classique (18 covariables)" = "solid",
  "Modèle dégradé (8 covariables)"  = "dashed"
)

formes_points <- c(
  "Modèle classique (18 covariables)" = 16,
  "Modèle dégradé (8 covariables)"  = 15
)

theme_custom <- theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = c(0.98, 0.05),
    legend.justification = c("right", "bottom"),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", 0.8)),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_blank()
  )

# --- Graphique 1 : AUC-ROC ---
p1 <- ggplot(df_combined, aes(x = date_deb, y = auc_moy, color = modele, linetype = modele, shape = modele)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = auc_moy - auc_std, ymax = auc_moy + auc_std), width = 2) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  geom_text(data = m, aes(x = date_deb, y = 0.98, label = label_annot), 
            inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 2.8, color = "dimgrey", vjust = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = palette_couleurs) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = styles_lignes) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = formes_points) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), oob = oob_keep) +
  scale_x_date(date_labels = "%d/%m", breaks = dates_semaines) +
  labs(title = "AUC-ROC par semaine — modèle classique vs. modèle dégradé (3 meilleurs folds)",
       y = "AUC-ROC") +
  theme_custom

# --- Graphique 2 : Kendall Tau ---
p2 <- ggplot(df_combined, aes(x = date_deb, y = kt_moy, color = modele, linetype = modele, shape = modele)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = kt_moy - kt_std, ymax = kt_moy + kt_std), width = 2) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  geom_text(data = m, aes(x = date_deb, y = 0.98, label = label_annot), 
            inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 2.8, color = "dimgrey", vjust = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = palette_couleurs) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = styles_lignes) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = formes_points) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), oob = oob_keep) +
  scale_x_date(date_labels = "%d/%m", breaks = dates_semaines) +
  labs(title = "Kendall τ par semaine — modèle classique vs. modèle dégradé (3 meilleurs folds)",
       y = "Kendall τ") +
  theme_custom

# --- Graphique 3 : iG-APEX ---
p3 <- ggplot(m, aes(x = date_deb, y = ic_apex_moy)) +
  geom_line(color = "#2ca02c", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ic_apex_moy - std_ic_apex, ymax = ic_apex_moy + std_ic_apex), 
                width = 2, color = "#2ca02c") +
  geom_point(color = "#2ca02c", shape = 18, size = 3) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), oob = oob_keep) +
  scale_x_date(date_labels = "%d/%m", breaks = dates_semaines) +
  labs(title = "iG-APEX observé (moyenne ± écart-type) par semaine",
       x = "Semaine (date de début)",
       y = "iG-APEX") +
  theme_custom +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 11, margin = margin(t = 10)),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

# --- Assemblage et affichage combiné ---
graphique_final <- p1 / p2 / p3
print(graphique_final)
ggsave("comparaison_hebdo_complet_R.png", plot = graphique_final, width = 12, height = 13, dpi = 200)

# --- Affichage et sauvegarde individuel en grand ---
theme_individuel <- theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 15)),
    legend.position = c(0.98, 0.05),
    legend.justification = c("right", "bottom"),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", 0.85), color = "grey80"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, margin = margin(t = 10)),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1, size = 11),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11)
  )

p1_grand <- p1 + theme_individuel + labs(x = "Semaine (date de début)")
p2_grand <- p2 + theme_individuel + labs(x = "Semaine (date de début)")
p3_grand <- p3 + theme_individuel

# Affichages
print(p1_grand)
print(p2_grand)
print(p3_grand)

# Exports HD
ggsave("graphe_1_auc_roc.png", plot = p1_grand, width = 10, height = 6.5, dpi = 300)
ggsave("graphe_2_kendall_tau.png", plot = p2_grand, width = 10, height = 6.5, dpi = 300)
ggsave("graphe_3_ig_apex.png", plot = p3_grand, width = 10, height = 6.5, dpi = 300)
```
